text: A number of residents on Ivor Road have contacted me to share their concerns about speed and volume issues on their street. Representatives from the neighbourhood submitted a petition signed by several households requesting that the speed limit be lowered to 30km/h on Ivor Road from Yonge Street to Donwoods Drive. Ivor Road is a residential street on a steep hill leading to other residential homes in the Hogg's Hollow neighbourhood.
North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40km/h to 30km/h on Ivor Road, between Yonge Street and Donwoods Drive.
